name: Ankle Pumps
instruction: Bend ankles to move feet up & down, alternating feet continuously.

name: Quad Sets
instruction: Slowly tighten muscles on thigh of straight leg while counting out loud. Push knee firmly into bed.

name: Gluteal Squeezes
instruction: Squeeze buttocks muscles as tightly as possible together. Hold for 5 seconds.

name: Heel Slides
instruction: Lie flat on bed. Bend knee & pull heel toward buttocks. Hold, then slide back straight.

name: Short Arc Quads
instruction: Place rolled towel under knee. Raise lower part of leg until knee is straight. Hold for 5 seconds.

name: Straight Leg Raises
instruction: Bend one leg. Keep other leg straight & slowly raise it 6-12 inches. Hold, then lower.

name: Straight Leg Raise (Inward & Outward)
instruction: Raise leg straight, then move slightly inward across midline or outward to side.

name: Hip Abduction (Knee Rehab)
instruction: Keep toes pointed up. Move leg out to side as far as possible, then return.

name: Long Arc Quads
instruction: Sit on sturdy chair. Straighten operated leg straight forward. Hold for 5 seconds.

name: Knee Slides (Post-Op)
instruction: Slowly slide foot forward in front of you until stretch is felt in knee. Hold 10 seconds.

name: Hip/Knee Flexion & Extension
instruction: Slide heel toward buttocks bending knee, then extend back straight.

name: Quad Sets (Chair Variant)
instruction: Seated on chair, press back of knee down toward seat cushion & tighten thigh.

name: Straight Leg Raises (Chair Variant)
instruction: Seated on chair, lift straight leg up to horizontal. Hold for 5 seconds.

name: Short Arc Quads (Chair Variant)
instruction: Seated with bolster under thigh, extend foot upward until knee locks.

name: Quad Sets with a Stool
instruction: Sit on chair with foot propped up on stool. Tighten thigh to press knee down.

name: Sitting Knee Flexion
instruction: Sit on chair with injured leg slightly bent. Bend knee backward under chair.

name: Gluteal Exercise
instruction: Lie on back. Squeeze gluteal muscles together, hold for 5 seconds & relax.

name: Quad Exercise
instruction: Lie on back. Push knee firmly down against floor & tighten thigh muscles.

name: Knee Lift
instruction: Lie on back. Pull each knee to chest in turn, keeping opposite leg straight.

name: Hip Abduction (Sliding Board Variant)
instruction: Using a sliding board under leg, bring leg out to side & back with toes facing ceiling.

name: Short Arc Quad (Hip Rehab)
instruction: Roll up towel & place under knee. Raise lower leg until knee is fully straight.

name: External Hip Rotation
instruction: Lie with knees bent & feet flat. Let one knee drop slowly out to side, then return.

name: Bridging
instruction: Lie on back with knees bent & feet flat. Lift hips up until body is straight.

name: Stomach Exercise (Abdominal Bracing)
instruction: Lie on back with knees bent. Pull belly button in toward floor & hold tight.

name: Hip Flexion
instruction: Hold work surface & march on spot, bringing knee up to 90 degrees.

name: Hip Abduction (Standing)
instruction: Lift leg sideways, keeping body upright. Do not lean forward.

name: Hip Extension
instruction: Move leg backward keeping knee straight. Clench buttock muscle.

name: Heel to Buttock
instruction: Bend knee to pull heel up toward buttock. Keep knee pointing straight down.

name: Hip Hitch
instruction: Standing straight, hitch your leg/hip up a couple inches off floor. Lower slowly.

name: Mini Squat
instruction: Hold onto work surface. Squat down until knees are slightly bent, then stand.

name: Hip Adduction
instruction: Attach cord/band to ankle, pull leg inward across midline.

name: Side Hip Abduction
instruction: Lie on side with knees bent or top leg straight. Lift top leg upward.

name: Bridge with Ball
instruction: Lie on floor with heels on exercise ball. Lift hips off floor maintaining core brace.

name: Unweighted Flexion (Standing)
instruction: Stand behind chair, flex leg up to 90 degree angle, then return.

name: Squats
instruction: Stand feet shoulder width apart. Lower body until thighs are horizontal.

name: Knee to Chest
instruction: Lie on back. Pull one or both knees up to chest with hands. Hold for 15 seconds.

name: Runner's Stretch
instruction: Step one leg forward into lunge, push hips forward until thigh/hip flexor stretches.

name: Advanced Reach
instruction: Sit or lie down, reach forward gently extending lumbar spine and shoulders.

name: Piriformis Stretch
instruction: Lie on back, cross one ankle over opposite knee, pull thigh toward chest.

name: Hyperextension
instruction: Lie face down, slowly raise chest and shoulders off mat.

name: Standing Back Extension
instruction: Stand with hands on lower back, gently arch spine backward.

name: Press Up / Sphinx Position
instruction: Lie flat on stomach. Push chest up on forearms keeping hips flat. Hold 10-15s.

name: Body Flexion
instruction: Bend forward gently at waist, sliding hands down thighs to stretch back.

name: Dog (Cat-Dog / Cat-Cow)
instruction: On hands & knees, alternate arching back up (cat) and dropping back down (dog).

name: Cat Stretch
instruction: Arch back up toward ceiling like an angry cat, tucking chin to chest.

name: Wrist Flexion
instruction: Forearm supported, gently bend wrist downward. Hold 5 seconds.

name: Wrist Extension
instruction: Forearm supported, gently bend wrist upward. Hold 5 seconds.

name: Side to Side (Wrist)
instruction: Move wrist side to side as if waving (radial/ulnar deviation).

name: Wrist Stretch
instruction: Extend arm, use opposite hand to pull hand back gently to stretch forearm.

name: Wrist Extension Stretch
instruction: Stand at table, press palms down with fingers pointing back.

name: Wrist Flexion Stretch
instruction: Stand at table, press back of hands down with fingers pointing back.

name: Grip Strengthening
instruction: Squeeze rubber ball or putty tightly in hand. Hold 5 seconds.

name: Circular Pendulum
instruction: Bend 90° at waist, support on table, swing hanging arm in circular motion.

name: Shoulder Flexion 1
instruction: Clasp hands together & lift arms above head keeping elbows straight.

name: Shoulder Abduction
instruction: Raise arm out to side with elbow straight & palm facing down. Hold 10s.

name: Supported Shoulder Rotation
instruction: Keep elbow in place & shoulder blades down, slide forearm back & forth.

name: Shoulder Internal Rotation
instruction: Bring hand behind back & across to opposite side.

name: Walk Up Exercise (Wall Climb)
instruction: Use fingers to crawl up a wall or door frame as far as possible.

name: Shoulder Flexion 2
instruction: Raise arm to point toward ceiling, keeping elbow straight.

name: Isometric Shoulder Extension
instruction: Stand with back to wall, push arms back into wall. Hold 5s.

name: Isometric Shoulder External Rotation
instruction: Stand side to wall, bend elbow 90°, push forearm outward against wall.

name: Isometric Shoulder Internal Rotation
instruction: Stand in doorway, bend elbow 90°, push arm inward against wall.

name: Neck Glide
instruction: Slowly slide chin backward (chin tuck). Hold 5 seconds.

name: Neck Extension
instruction: Tilt head backward looking upward. Hold 5 seconds.

name: Neck Rotation
instruction: Slowly turn head to left, then right. Hold 10 seconds each side.

name: Resistance Presses
instruction: Apply hand pressure to head while resisting movement. Hold 5s.

name: Lateral Extension
instruction: Use hand to gently stretch neck sideways toward shoulder. Hold 5s.

name: Shoulder Shrugs
instruction: Raise both shoulders up toward ears, hold for 5 seconds.

name: Tilted Forward Flexion
instruction: Lower chin toward chest, tilt head slightly forward. Hold 5s.

name: Deep Stretching
instruction: Sit upright, tilt head toward shoulder, hold chair with opposite hand.

name: Towel Pull
instruction: Place rolled towel around neck, apply gentle pressure while extending spine.
